newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Strauss sees Danone accord by year end.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Strauss sees Danone accord by year end.

text.p: Nahariya Dairy Strauss Ltd said on Thursday it hoped to conclude a final agreement with French food group Danone for it to take a minority stake in the Israeli food company by the end of the year.
Under the terms of the agreement, Danone will purchase 20 percent of the privately-owned Strauss, one of Israel's largest food manufacturers and the leading supplier of ice cream.

Strauss chairman and chief executive Michael Strauss told Reuters that press reports that the 20 percent stake would be sold for $40 million to $60 million were incorrect and that the deal had yet to be completed.
"The lawyers of both sides are involved in finalising the agreement," he said.

Strauss currently produces a number of Danone products under licence. Strauss said he expected cooperation between the two companies to increase further into new product fields. He also said he hoped Strauss would be able to export Danone products from Israel to nearby countries.
Unilever has a 50 percent stake in Strauss's ice cream operations.
